headlines.title: From 2016: Anthony Bourdain Talks Career and Fatherhood
headlines.description: World-renowned chef, author and culinary adventurer Anthony Bourdain sits down with Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist to enjoy some exotic dishes over a conversation around his journey from the kitchen to global stardom, sharing a meal with President Barack Obama and his daughter’s brutal criticism. This originally aired on Oct. 23, 2016.

headlines.title: Puerto Rico crisis worsens with hundreds of thousands without water
headlines.description: The water crisis in Puerto Rico was growing even more dire on Saturday, with people taking desperate measures to conserve water during a major drought. NBC News’ George Solis reports.

headlines.title: Pizzeria owner responds to viral birthday cake video after backlash
headlines.description: The owner of a Jersey Shore pizzeria called Joey Tomato's is responding after a viral video appears to show a staffer yelling at customers for bringing a birthday cake, and asking for a knife to cut it. NBC News' Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Hundreds of thousands without water in Puerto Rico
headlines.description: Families and businesses in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and nearby towns now have to make do with whatever water they have on hand amid rolling shutoffs that last for 48 hours at a time. NBC News' George Solis is on the ground.

headlines.title: West Nile virus season peaks in late August — here’s what you can use to stay safe
headlines.description: West Nile virus cases typically peak in late summer. Here’s how it spreads, the symptoms to watch for and expert-backed tips to avoid mosquito bites.

headlines.title: Dermstore Anniversary Sale: The best deals to shop this week
headlines.description: Dermstore’s Anniversary Sale includes deals of up to 25% off bestselling brands like Cosrx, Sunday Riley, Supergoop and more.

headlines.title: You won’t want to wait until winter to return these recalled handwarmers — here’s why
headlines.description: Ocoopa has recalled 1.5 million rechargeable hand warmers after reports of fires, burns and one death. Here’s what happened, how to check your device and safer alternatives.

headlines.title: The best self-emptying cordless stick vacuums you should know about
headlines.description: I spoke to several home appliance and vacuum experts to find the best self-emptying vacuums, including ones from top brands like Dyson and Shark.

headlines.title: New Year's Eve ball drops in Times Square for America's 250th
headlines.description: The New Year's Eve ball in Times Square has dropped for America's 250th anniversary, making this the first time the ball has dropped outside of a New Year's celebration.

headlines.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s mega-yacht did not respond to call for help from small boat in Alaska
headlines.description: META billionaire Mark Zuckerberg’s mega-yacht, Launchpad, did not respond to a call from help a stranded skiff off the coast of Alaska.

headlines.title: The U.S. just had its hottest month on record
headlines.description: The United States sweltered through its hottest July ever recorded last month, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration confirmed Monday.

headlines.title: Slain Arizona student planned to break up with her Indian boyfriend, arrest warrant says
headlines.description: The University of Arizona student who was killed in her Tucson apartment planned to break up with her Indian boyfriend and feared for her safety in the relationship, according to findings in an arrest warrant filed with the court in Pima County.
